Services.title: Services
Services.description: Work OrgTik's team does for you. Package prices are in {currency}; the others are quoted for your brief.

catalog.failedBody: Check your connection and try again.
catalog.subscriber: As a subscriber you get {pct}% off. It shows as its own line on every quote.
catalog.notSubscriber: Workspaces on a paid plan get a discount on every quote.
catalog.memberNote: Only the owner and admins can request a service. Ask them if you need one.

new.title: Request a service
new.description: Tell us what you need. OrgTik reviews your brief and sends a quote.
new.titleHint: A short name for this piece of work.
new.briefHint: What you need, for whom, and anything we should know. At least {min} characters ({count} so far).
new.budgetHint: Roughly what you plan to spend, in {currency}.
new.next: Nothing is charged now. The owner sees the quote and decides whether to accept and pay it.

errors.briefShort: Write at least {min} characters so we can quote it.

requests.title: Service requests
requests.description: Everything the workspace has asked OrgTik to do, and what happens next.
requests.emptyBody: Pick a service and send a brief; you get a quote before anything is charged.
requests.emptyBodyMember: When the owner or an admin requests a service, it shows here.

next.payOwner: Waiting for the owner to pay

detail.missingBody: It may belong to another workspace than {name}.
detail.failedBody: Check your connection and try again.

errors.paymentFailed: The payment didn't go through. Nothing was charged. Try another card.
errors.noCard: There's no working card on the workspace. Add one, then pay.
errors.expired: This quote has expired. Ask for a new one in the messages.
errors.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can do this, because it's a payment.

detail.messageNote: OrgTik's team answers here and by email.
detail.acceptImpact: Next you pay <total></total> with the workspace's default card. Work starts once it's paid.
detail.accepted: Quote accepted. Pay to start the work.
detail.payImpact: We charge the workspace's default card and send you the invoice. Work starts once the payment goes through.
detail.declineImpact: OrgTik is told and the quote can't be accepted any more. You can still ask for a new one.
detail.approveImpact: The request moves to Completed. Ask for revisions instead if something needs to change.
detail.cancelImpact: OrgTik stops working on it and its quote can't be accepted. Nothing has been charged.
detail.noQuoteYet: OrgTik is reviewing your brief. The quote shows here when it's ready.
detail.expiredBody: It can't be accepted any more. Write to OrgTik below and they'll send a new one.
detail.ownerDecides: Only the workspace owner can accept or decline a quote, because it's a payment.
detail.toPayBody: You accepted this quote. Pay <total></total> and OrgTik starts.
detail.ownerPays: The quote is accepted. Work starts once the owner pays.
detail.declinedBody: Ask for a new quote in the messages if you change your mind.
detail.autoApprove: If nobody answers, it's approved automatically on {date}.
detail.adminApproves: The owner or an admin approves the delivery or asks for revisions.
detail.noMessages: No messages yet. Ask OrgTik anything about this request.
detail.reviseBody: The work goes back in progress, and OrgTik delivers again.
